corrected_nonclassifying_line_diagnostic.note: The original Exp071N evaluator incorrectly compared the positive-branch line angle to the raw oriented negative-branch angle. This diagnostic bug does not enter the preregistered four-angle PASS/FAIL rule. Correct line consistency compares min(theta,180-theta) on both branches.

scientific_interpretation: A physically independent two-sided primordial-tilt nuisance line overlaps both tested positive GDM rays in the preregistered linear velocity-power-shape representation. Thus the earlier positive-K2 oriented velocity separation is not a generic known-sector specificity theorem. Representation choice also matters: K1 is exactly null in transfer-only t_tot space but becomes resolvable once the primordial-power factor is included.
